applyTo: "**/*"

# Framework Conventions

- JavaScript only.
- Playwright + Cucumber.
- Feature files belong under `features/`.
- Step definitions belong under `features/step-definitions/`.
- Support files belong under `features/support/`.
- Page objects belong under `src/pages/`.
- Locator modules belong under `src/locators/`.
- Utilities belong under `src/utils/`.
- Data belongs under `src/data/`.
- Reports are generated by the existing runner/report utilities.
- Do not treat `ai-demo/` as source code; it is evidence only.

Most important rule:

```text
Locators own selectors.
Page objects own workflows.
Step definitions call page objects.
```

Additional conventions:
- Keep step definitions thin and business-readable.
- Page objects should import locator modules and expose workflows.
- Utilities should own common actions, waits, assertions, screenshots, logging, and reporting.
- Avoid selectors in step definitions and avoid hardcoded selectors in page objects unless documented.
- Prefer shared utilities over duplicate implementation.
